Theo CSM: Arcadia dedicated bring-up scheduled Fri 06:00 PST. Need final quota runway, autoscale policy, and a 20m smoke + 10m peak burst test. Renewal in ~95 days so want clean telemetry.
Rina SE: Do we have their expected sustained vs burst and avg token sizes?
Theo CSM: Arcadia sent baseline: sustained ~40rps, marketing pushes cause 600rps bursts for ~6m, nightly batch adds ~25rps for 45m. Avg tokens ~60.
Omar SRE: Recommend runway = 6x sustained (240rps) and preapproved burst headroom to 700rps for 10m. Will insist on KV priming before test.
Priya Eng: Draft autoscale: min_replicas=1, target_rps=80, scale_step=+2, max_replicas=10, burst_policy=allow(10m)->fallback-quantized. Posting JSON after lunch.
Theo CSM: Proposed test: shadow 20m with ramp to peak, then routed 10m at 30% traffic if shadow ok. Collect p50/p95/p99, errors, cache_hit_ratio, token consumption.
Rina SE: Load command (k6): `k6 run --vus 150 --duration 20m arcadia_ramp.js --out json=arc-shadow.json` ramp stages in script to reproduce marketing spike.
Omar SRE: Warmup priming: `seq 1 1200 | xargs -n1 -P8 -I{} curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/prime -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"seed {}"}'` run 30m before shadow.
deploybot: scheduler: created job ac-2024-555 for 1755633600 (Fri 06:00 PST)
Priya Eng: Metric guardrails: abort routed if 5xx>0.5% or p95>700ms. Track fallback count and quality diffs.
Theo CSM: Renewal risk: if routed soak shows repeated fallbacks or >1% 5xx, mark "At-Risk" and set a remediation sprint.
Rina SE: Canary rollout plan: 5% for 20m -> 25% for 30m -> full. Rollback if error-delta >0.5%.
Priya Eng: Posting autoscale JSON: `{ "min":1, "max":10, "target_rps":80, "burst_headroom":700, "burst_window_mins":10 }` :white_check_mark:
deploybot: run-complete: ac-2024-555 -> status: shadow_ok, p95: 240ms, p99: 590ms, 5xx: 0.12% (artifacts: s3://arcadia/case-112/ac-2024-555)
Theo CSM: Shadow passed. Scheduling routed 10m soak at 07:30 PST per plan. I'll send enablement invite for 09:00 PST (short dashboards + runbook).
Omar SRE: I'll monitor cache_hit_ratio; if it drops below 70% we pause and re-prime.
Rina SE: Uploading load scripts and ramp CSV to case: AC-112.
Theo CSM: Thanks team. If routed soak is green, we'll close bring-up and add a one-slide summary to the renewal file.
